'''Shar-Da''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Voss commandos|Commando]] who lived on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] he was stationed at the medical center in [[Camp Talanis]] in the [[Gormak Lands]]. He thanked a Republic citizen who brought to him the medical supplies recovered from the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]].
